paper_standard_reference.notes: Width/thickness/tail dimensions come from the paper/preprint supplementary simulation; the published protocol notes many standard three-tail samples used ~0.4 mm veneer, so 0.5 mm is retained here to match the EECS149 machine specification and the simulation geometry.

large_whitebark_pine_reference.notes: Exact large-tail lengths and exact tip mold geometry were not provided in the accessible article text, so PR23 omits the tails rather than inventing them.
